sbd_device.description: Primary shared disk device used for SBD fencing (e.g., a persistent reservation-capable SCSI-3 device).

sbd_devices.description: Additional shared disk devices (optional). If provided, overrides SBD_DEVICE.

items.description: Path to a shared storage device suitable for SBD (e.g., /dev/disk/by-id/...)

sbd_watchdog_ticks.description: Number of watchdog timeout intervals before SBD initiates a reboot (must match cluster configuration).

sbd_retries.description: Number of attempts per watchdog interval before escalating to reboot.

sbd_delay_start.description: Seconds to wait before starting SBD service (allows disks to settle).

sbd_timeout_start.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop gracefully before forcing a reboot.

sbd_timeout_stop.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop during system shutdown before forcing a reboot.

sbd_enabled.description: Set to 'yes' to enable SBD fencing, or 'no' to disable (not recommended in production clusters).

sbd_pidfile.description: Path to the SBD daemon PID file.

sbd_debug_log.description: Optional path to a debug log file (e.g., /var/log/sbd.log). Leave empty to disable debug logging.
